maria gomez: Quick heads-up — Arm Neoverse early access request landed this morning. Partner wants a 6-week preview to validate our quantized 8-bit kernels + end-to-end latency on their N2 silicon. They mentioned an NDA template but want us to sign before sharing microcode/board images.
raj patel: Got it. Do we have a standing NDA with Arm or do we need legal to spin one up?@legal?
emily chen: We don't have a current Master NDA for silicon-level access. I'll ping legal. Meanwhile can we scope the benchmark matrix so we can ask them for the exact workloads?
oliver kwon: I can lead perf runs. Need to know target SLOs and what model family they care about. Is this for our text-generation models or embeddings?
maria gomez: Partner said "LLM inference: gen + chat" — likely 7B & 13B families. SLOs: p50 < 60ms for 512 tokens (single-stream) and throughput targets for batch sizes 8/16. Also they want to test cold-start KV cache behavior.
ian foster: Add note: we should require sanitized prompt set from partner and include a subset of our standard redwood-regression prompts to compare quality. If microcode impacts determinism we'll need seed controls.
partner-bot: Created CRM EAP case EAP-ARM-NEOVERSE-2026-01 and assigned to partnerships queue. Slack thread linked: https://redwood.internal/eap/EAP-ARM-NEOVERSE-2026-01
raj patel: Ok next steps: 1) Emily -> legal for NDA (target: 48h), 2) Oliver -> perf harness + initial config, 3) Maria -> coordinate partner contact and request microbench images + sanitized prompts, 4) Ian -> infra: reserve a Dedicated small pool (2x A100-equivalent) or ask partner for board access.
emily chen: Legal responded: they prefer to use Arm's mutual NDA with our standard cybersecurity addendum. They asked for a contact and to confirm scope. I put draft in Drive: https://drive.redwood/legal/arm_eap_ndadraft_v1.md
oliver kwon: Drafted initial run command for perf team to iterate locally (will containerize):
```
./run_bench --model redwood/13b-gpt --device neoverse-n2 --quant 8 --batch 4 --seq 512 --measure latency,throughput --kv-cache true
```
Will push results to the perf board. Need test corpus — Maria, can you confirm sanitized prompt list?
maria gomez: I'll request their sanitized prompts and also attach our regression set. Ask partner to sign NDA before we accept images. I'll copy the exact SLOs in the email.
ian foster: Infra note: if partner wants board-level access we should insist on isolated VPC + ephemeral keys. For Dedicated pool we can simulate Neoverse perf on our cloud instances but should flag differences.
raj patel: Timeline proposal: NDA signed by 2 business days, infra + perf harness ready in 5 business days, first benchmark pass end of week after that. Does that work?
emily chen: Sounds fine. I'll chase legal today and loop in security for the addendum.
oliver kwon: Also proposing a quick smoke run within 48 hours of hardware or image access to validate toolchain. Need a perf engineer to be on standby for that window. Who's available?
maria gomez: @oliver you'll lead, @ian you'll provision. I'll handle partner comms. Raj will coordinate exec updates.
ian foster: I'll schedule the Dedicated pool and create a runbook entry: "arm-neoverse-eap" with rollback/fallback to host-model variant if microcode fails.
partner-bot: Reminder: partner requires a one-page plan and sign-off before they send images. Template: https://redwood.internal/templates/eap-plan.md
raj patel: I'll draft the 1-pager and post by EOD. Key asks: NDA status, SLOs, datasets, infra access, timeline, contact list.
emily chen: Legal asked for an org chart and data flow diagram for the EAP. Maria — can you produce a simple diagram or link to our architecture page?
maria gomez: Yep, linking our private architecture doc and a quick diagram: https://drive.redwood/partnerships/arm_eap_arch.png. Sending partner a minimal data flow + MSP contact list now.
oliver kwon: Small checklist for perf team: 
- containerize run_bench (CI job)
- add seed control to ensure determinism
- enable kv-cache trace logging for first 256 tokens
- capture power/thermals if partner provides board telemetry
I'll open GH issue and tag perf/team.
ian foster: Good. Also set up a short Slack huddle channel for the EAP: #eap-arm-neoverse for realtime notes.
maria gomez: Thanks everyone. I'll privatize the prompt set and loop partner once NDA is in place. If legal stalls more than 48h we'll escalate. :thumbsup:
raj patel: :shipit:
